facts.text: Notebook (feed): After getting their first win in their franchise history the Oaks followed with their second win in the very next game. The Oaks traveled to Detroit where its defense would shine in a 91-78 victory. Adash Stanley shined with 29 points while Austin Rivers facilitated the action with 10 assists while also contributing 12 points a 7 rebounds. AJ Dybansta continued his strong start and little spoken on second round pick , rookie Harry Hayward emergered with 12 points
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C113: The Oaks win again behind a big game behind Adash Stanley. The Oaks 91 - Pistons 78 on the road in Detroit.

Notebook (feed): Watch out now but the Oaks have won three straight games to start the inauguaral season. This time the Oaks traveled to New York to face the Knicks and had another convincing win beting the Knicks 115-93. Austin Reaves and AJ Dybansta lead scoring with 23 points a piece while Adash Stanley flirted with his first triple double. Harry Hayward repeats his strong performance recording a double double.
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C113: The Oaks remain sizzling hot after a winless preseason have now shot out of the gate winning 3 straight. Oaks 115 - Knicks 93 in New York

Notebook (feed): The Oaks now have won their first 4 games to start their first season in the NBA. This latest being the most jarring yet. The Oaks traveled to Washington and blew out the Wizards with a score of 105-62. A 43 point win in just their forth game speaks to the roster configuration and the coaching in the young season. Adash Stanley and Austin Reaves both scored 23 respectively in a game that mainly featured well orchestrated defense by the Oaks
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C113: The Oaks completly dismantle the Wizards in Washington. Oaks 105 - Wizards 62
